reportPurpose: Fully procedural asset and appearance revision, with fractured slate, asymmetric foliage, closed impeller blades, dimensioned optics and restrained material finishes. No scans, photos, image-generated textures or downloaded models. Physical Adreno performance is not verified.
userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/144.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

gpu.shadingLanguage: WebGL GLSL ES 3.00 (OpenGL ES GLSL ES 3.0 Chromium)

renderer: Two-pass raster: finite position-aware reflection panels, freshly baked illumination, procedural material processes, solid cached optics; optional memory-bounded coverage resolve

antialiasing.type: Native MSAA coverage plus spatial edge resolve; no temporal history
antialiasing.allocationPolicy: Extra coverage only below 1.8M pixels and within 256 MiB estimated application resources. Dense native phone buffers keep their original two attachments.

memory.excludes: Browser presentation buffers, driver alignment/metadata, shaders, transient upload copies and HTML/JS memory. This is an allocation-size estimate, not measured VRAM.

surfaceMaps.normalEncoding: tangent XYZ mapped 0..1; AO in alpha
surfaceMaps.source: Deterministic process-based surface fields; linear albedo, roughness, height-derived normals. No scans or photographs.

flameVolume.source: Offline buoyancy/advection/pressure-projection flow, heat and fuel; simplified combustion. Six-volume crossfade closes the presentation loop. Not a validated fire solver.
flameVolume.presentation: Volume stretched vertically into the exhibit and translated to the burner; turbulent sub-grid shading is artistic, not resolved combustion.

geometrySource: Entirely procedural: cleavage-plane schist, rooted asymmetric broadleaf tree, closed airfoil impeller, spherical bearing balls, dimensioned mechanical housings. No scans, photographs, generated imagery, or imported models.
limitations: Assets have been reconstructed, but remain authored procedural assets, not photographs or scans.
Static illumination and reflection captures; cached glass cannot track moving occluded geometry.
No depth-of-field or path-traced refinement. Coverage MSAA is memory-bounded and not enabled on dense phone buffers.
GPU memory figures are format-sized estimates, not driver memory measurements.
Physical Adreno performance and stability have not been verified by the build environment.
